1171: Why do you irrigate barren soil? You are wasting your life.
ਕਾਚੀ ਢਹਗਿ ਦਿਵਾਲ; ਕਾਹੇ ਗਚੁ ਲਾਵਹੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
The wall of mud will crumble; why bother to plaster it? ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
ਕਰ ਹਰਿਹਟ, ਮਾਲ ਟਿੰਡ ਪਰੋਵਹੁ; ਤਿਸੁ ਭੀਤਰਿ ਮਨੁ ਜੋਵਹੁ ॥
Let your hands be the buckets, strung on the chain of the Persian wheel, and yoke the mind as the ox to it.
ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਸਿੰਚਹੁ. ਭਰਹੁ ਕਿਆਰੇ; ਤਉ ਮਾਲੀ ਕੇ ਹੋਵਹੁ ॥੨॥
Irrigate with nectar and fill the beds; then you shall belong to the Gardener. ॥2॥
ਕਾਮੁ ਕ੍ਰੋਧੁ ਦੁਇ. ਕਰਹੁ ਬਸੋਲੇ; ਗੋਡਹੁ ਧਰਤੀ ਭਾਈ ॥
Let love and anger be your two hoes, and dig the soil of the body, O brother.
ਜਿਉ ਗੋਡਹੁ. ਤਿਉ ਤੁਮੑ ਸੁਖ ਪਾਵਹੁ; ਕਿਰਤੁ. ਨ ਮੇਟਿਆ ਜਾਈ ॥੩॥
The more you dig, the more peace you will find; such labour is never erased. ॥3॥
ਬਗੁਲੇ ਤੇ ਫੁਨਿ ਹੰਸੁਲਾ ਹੋਵੈ; ਜੇ ਤੂ ਕਰਹਿ ਦਇਆਲਾ ॥
The heron becomes a swan, if You so will, O Merciful Lord.
ਪ੍ਰਣਵਤਿ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਦਾਸਨਿ ਦਾਸਾ; ਦਇਆ ਕਰਹੁ ਦਇਆਲਾ ॥੪॥੧॥੯॥
Prays Nanak, the slave of Your slaves: be merciful, O Merciful Lord. ॥4॥1॥9॥
ਸਾਹੁਰੜੀ ਵਥੁ. ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਸਾਝੀ; ਪੇਵਕੜੈ ਧਨ ਵਖੇ ॥
The gift from my Husband's home is meant to be shared by all, but in my parents' home this bride learnt to keep apart.
ਆਪਿ ਕੁਚਜੀ. ਦੋਸੁ, ਨ ਦੇਊ; ਜਾਣਾ ਨਾਹੀ. ਰਖੇ ॥੧॥
I myself am ill-mannered; I blame no one else. I did not know how to keep it safe. ॥1॥
ਮੇਰੇ ਸਾਹਿਬਾ; ਹਉ ਆਪੇ ਭਰਮਿ ਭੁਲਾਣੀ ॥
O my Master, I myself am deluded by doubt.
ਅਖਰ ਲਿਖੇ ਸੇਈ ਗਾਵਾ; ਅਵਰ. ਨ ਜਾਣਾ ਬਾਣੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
I sing only what is written; I know no other word. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
ਕਢਿ ਕਸੀਦਾ. ਪਹਿਰਹਿ ਚੋਲੀ; ਤਾਂ ਤੁਮੑ ਜਾਣਹੁ ਨਾਰੀ ॥
Only if she embroiders her gown with virtues and wears it, know her to be a true wife;
ਜੇ ਘਰੁ ਰਾਖਹਿ. ਬੁਰਾ ਨ ਚਾਖਹਿ; ਹੋਵਹਿ ਕੰਤ ਪਿਆਰੀ ॥੨॥
if she guards her home and does not taste evil, she becomes dear to her Husband. ॥2॥
ਜੇ ਤੂੰ ਪੜਿਆ ਪੰਡਿਤੁ ਬੀਨਾ; ਦੁਇ ਅਖਰ. ਦੁਇ ਨਾਵਾ ॥
If you are truly learned, a wise pandit, know that the Name is the boat.
ਪ੍ਰਣਵਤਿ ਨਾਨਕੁ. ਏਕੁ ਲੰਘਾਏ; ਜੇ ਕਰਿ ਸਚਿ ਸਮਾਵਾਂ ॥੩॥੨॥੧੦॥
Prays Nanak, the One Lord carries us across, if I remain absorbed in the True One. ॥3॥2॥10॥
ਰਾਜਾ ਬਾਲਕੁ. ਨਗਰੀ ਕਾਚੀ; ਦੁਸਟਾ ਨਾਲਿ ਪਿਆਰੋ ॥
The king is a child, the city is fragile, and he loves wicked companions.
ਦੁਇ ਮਾਈ. ਦੁਇ ਬਾਪਾ ਪੜੀਅਹਿ; ਪੰਡਿਤ ਕਰਹੁ ਬੀਚਾਰੋ ॥੧॥
He is said to have two mothers and two fathers; reflect on this, O pandit. ॥1॥
O master pandit, what understanding do you give?
How shall I find the Lord of my life? ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
ਭੀਤਰਿ ਅਗਨਿ. ਬਨਾਸਪਤਿ ਮਉਲੀ; ਸਾਗਰੁ ਪੰਡੈ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
There is fire within the flourishing vegetation, and the ocean is held within a lump of earth.
ਚੰਦੁ ਸੂਰਜੁ ਦੁਇ. ਘਰ ਹੀ ਭੀਤਰਿ; ਐਸਾ ਗਿਆਨੁ. ਨ ਪਾਇਆ ॥੨॥
The sun and the moon both dwell in the same home; you have not obtained such wisdom. ॥2॥
ਰਾਮ ਰਵੰਤਾ ਜਾਣੀਐ; ਇਕ ਮਾਈ ਭੋਗੁ ਕਰੇਇ ॥
Know that one who dwells on the Lord has destroyed the one mother, ignorance.
ਤਾ ਕੇ ਲਖਣ ਜਾਣੀਅਹਿ; ਖਿਮਾ ਧਨੁ ਸੰਗ੍ਰਹੇਇ ॥੩॥
The signs of such a person are known: he gathers the wealth of forgiveness. ॥3॥
ਕਹਿਆ ਸੁਣਹਿ ਨ ਖਾਇਆ ਮਾਨਹਿ; ਤਿਨੑਾ ਹੀ ਸੇਤੀ ਵਾਸਾ ॥
The mind dwells with those who do not listen to what is said and are never satisfied with what they consume.
ਪ੍ਰਣਵਤਿ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਦਾਸਨਿ ਦਾਸਾ; ਖਿਨੁ ਤੋਲਾ ਖਿਨੁ ਮਾਸਾ ॥੪॥੩॥੧੧॥
Prays Nanak, the slave of Your slaves: one moment it is large, the next moment small. ॥4॥3॥11॥
ਸਾਚਾ ਸਾਹੁ ਗੁਰੂ ਸੁਖਦਾਤਾ; ਹਰਿ ਮੇਲੇ. ਭੁਖ ਗਵਾਏ ॥
The Guru is the True Banker, the Giver of peace; He unites one with the Lord and takes away hunger.
ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਹਰਿ ਭਗਤਿ ਦ੍ਰਿੜਾਏ; ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਏ ॥੧॥
In His mercy He implants devotion to the Lord, and night and day one sings the Lord's praises. ॥1॥
ਮਤ ਭੂਲਹਿ; ਰੇ ਮਨ ਚੇਤਿ ਹਰੀ ॥
Do not forget, O mind; remember the Lord.
ਬਿਨੁ ਗੁਰ. ਮੁਕਤਿ ਨਾਹੀ. ਤ੍ਰੈ ਲੋਈ; ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਪਾਈਐ ਨਾਮੁ ਹਰੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Without the Guru, no one is liberated anywhere in the three worlds; as Guru-facing, one obtains the Lord's Name. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
ਬਿਨੁ ਭਗਤੀ. ਨਹੀ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਪਾਈਐ; ਬਿਨੁ ਭਾਗਾ. ਨਹੀ ਭਗਤਿ ਹਰੀ ॥
Without devotion, the True Guru is not found; without good destiny, devotion to the Lord is not obtained.
ਬਿਨੁ ਭਾਗਾ. ਸਤਸੰਗੁ, ਨ ਪਾਈਐ; ਕਰਮਿ ਮਿਲੈ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਹਰੀ ॥੨॥
Without good destiny, the true congregation is not found; by His grace one receives the Lord's Name. ॥2॥
ਘਟਿ ਘਟਿ ਗੁਪਤੁ ਉਪਾਏ ਵੇਖੈ; ਪਰਗਟੁ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸੰਤ ਜਨਾ ॥
Hidden in each and every heart, He creates and watches over all; He is revealed to the Guru-facing saints.
ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਕਰਹਿ. ਸੁ ਹਰਿ ਰੰਗਿ ਭੀਨੇ; ਹਰਿ ਜਲੁ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਨਾਮੁ ਮਨਾ ॥੩॥
Those who chant the Lord's Name, Har Har, are drenched in His love; the nectar Name, the Lord's water, fills their minds. ॥3॥
1172: ਜਿਨ ਕਉ ਤਖਤਿ ਮਿਲੈ ਵਡਿਆਈ; ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸੇ ਪਰਧਾਨ ਕੀਏ ॥
Those blessed with glory on the throne — the Guru-facing are made eminent.
ਪਾਰਸੁ ਭੇਟਿ. ਭਏ ਸੇ ਪਾਰਸ; ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਰ ਸੰਗਿ ਥੀਏ ॥੪॥੪॥੧੨॥
Touching the philosopher's stone, they become philosopher's stones themselves; Nanak, they become companions of the Lord and the Guru. ॥4॥4॥12॥
Basant · Dutuke · Guru Amar Das · Ghar 1
One Creator, realised by the Guru's grace
Through all the months and seasons, You are the ever-present spring,
by whom all beings and creatures flourish.
What can I say? I am a mere worm.
ਤੇਰਾ ਕਿਨੈ. ਨ ਪਾਇਆ ਆਦਿ ਅੰਤੁ ॥੧॥
No one has found Your beginning or Your end. ॥1॥
Those who serve You, O Master,
ਪਰਮ ਸੁਖ ਪਾਵਹਿ; ਆਤਮ ਦੇਵ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
obtain supreme peace, O divine Lord of the soul. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
When He shows grace, one serves Him;
by the Guru's grace, one remains dead while yet alive;
night and day one chants the True Name;
in this way the mortal crosses the treacherous world-ocean. ॥2॥
The Creator created both poison and nectar;
ਸੰਸਾਰ ਬਿਰਖ ਕਉ; ਦੁਇ ਫਲ ਲਾਏ ॥
He attached these two fruits to the tree of the world.
The Creator Himself does and causes all to be done;
He feeds each as He pleases. ॥3॥
Nanak, one upon whom He casts His glance of grace,
He Himself gives the nectar Name;
He brings under control the desire for corruption in the mind;
He Himself carries out His own will. ॥4॥1॥
Those imbued with the True Lord's Name are enraptured.
Have mercy, O God, Merciful to the meek.
ਤਿਸੁ ਬਿਨੁ; ਅਵਰੁ. ਨਹੀ ਮੈ ਕੋਇ ॥
Without Him I have no other;
as it pleases Him, He preserves me. ॥1॥
The Guru, the Lord of the world, is pleasing to my mind.
ਰਹਿ. ਨ ਸਕਉ, ਦਰਸਨ ਦੇਖੇ ਬਿਨੁ; ਸਹਜਿ ਮਿਲਉ ਗੁਰੁ ਮੇਲਿ ਮਿਲਾਏ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
I cannot live without seeing His sight; I meet Him in poise when the Guru unites me in union. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
This greedy mind is enticed by greed;
forgetting the Lord, it repents in the end.
The separated are reunited, imbued with service to the Guru;
the Lord's Name is given to those with good fortune on their foreheads. ॥2॥
ਪਉਣ ਪਾਣੀ ਕੀ; ਇਹ ਦੇਹ ਸਰੀਰਾ ॥
This body is made of air and water;
the body suffers the terrible pain of the disease of ego.
ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਦਾਰੂ; ਗੁਣ ਗਾਇਆ ॥
The Guru-facing have the medicine of the Lord's Name; they sing His praises;
in His mercy, the Guru has cured the disease. ॥3॥
Four rivers of fire flow through the body;
it burns in the fire of craving and ego.
Those whom the Guru protects, the very fortunate, are saved;
ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ; ਉਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਧਾਰੇ ॥੪॥੨॥
servant Nanak enshrines the nectar of the Lord in the heart. ॥4॥2॥
ਹਰਿ ਸੇਵੇ; ਸੋ ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਲੋਗੁ ॥
One who serves the Lord is the Lord's person;
ਸਾਚੁ ਸਹਜੁ; ਕਦੇ. ਨ ਹੋਵੈ ਸੋਗੁ ॥
he dwells in true poise and never grieves.
ਮਨਮੁਖ ਮੁਏ; ਨਾਹੀ ਹਰਿ ਮਨ ਮਾਹਿ ॥
The self-willed are dead; the Lord is not in their minds;
ਮਰਿ ਮਰਿ ਜੰਮਹਿ; ਭੀ ਮਰਿ ਜਾਹਿ ॥੧॥
they die and die again, and are reborn only to die once more. ॥1॥
ਸੇ ਜਨ ਜੀਵੇ; ਜਿਨ ਹਰਿ ਮਨ ਮਾਹਿ ॥
They alone live who have the Lord in their minds;
they cherish the True One and merge in the True One. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
ਹਰਿ. ਨ ਸੇਵਹਿ; ਤੇ ਹਰਿ ਤੇ ਦੂਰਿ ॥
Those who do not serve the Lord are far from the Lord;
they wander in foreign lands with dust on their heads.
The Lord Himself attaches His humble servants to Himself;
ਤਿਨ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਹੈ; ਤਿਲੁ. ਨ ਤਮਾਇ ॥੨॥
they are ever at peace and have not a speck of greed. ॥2॥
1173: When He casts His glance of grace, pride is dispelled,
and one is honoured in the True Court.
One sees the dear Lord ever present,
pervading everywhere through the Guru's Word. ॥3॥
He cherishes all beings and creatures;
by the Guru's grace, remember Him forever.
ਦਰਿ ਸਾਚੈ; ਪਤਿ ਸਿਉ ਘਰਿ ਜਾਇ ॥
At the True Door one goes home with honour;
Nanak, through the Name one obtains glory. ॥4॥3॥
One who worships within, from the mind,
sees the One alone and no other.
People in duality suffer great pain;
the True Guru has shown me the One. ॥1॥
My God has blossomed forth; it is ever spring.
ਇਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਮਉਲਿਆ; ਗਾਇ ਗੁਣ ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
This mind blossoms, singing the praises of the Lord of the universe. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
Consult the Guru and reflect on His teachings;
then you shall love the True Lord God.
Abandon your ego and be His loving servant,
and the Life of the world shall come to dwell in your mind. ॥2॥
One who worships Him sees Him ever present;
my God is ever fully pervading.
ਇਸੁ ਭਗਤੀ ਕਾ; ਕੋਈ ਜਾਣੈ ਭੇਉ ॥
Rare is the one who knows the mystery of this devotion:
my God, the divine Lord, is in all. ॥3॥
He Himself unites one in union with the True Guru;
He Himself attaches one's awareness to the Life of the world.
Mind and body are rejuvenated with natural ease;
Nanak, one remains lovingly attuned to the Name. ॥4॥4॥
ਭਗਤਿ ਵਛਲੁ ਹਰਿ; ਵਸੈ ਮਨਿ ਆਇ ॥
The Lord, Lover of His devotees, comes to dwell in the mind
with natural ease, by the Guru's grace.
One who worships Him, eradicating ego from within,
then and only then is united with the True One. ॥1॥
ਭਗਤ ਸੋਹਹਿ ਸਦਾ; ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਦੁਆਰਿ ॥
The devotees are ever beautiful at the Lord God's door,
ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਹੇਤਿ; ਸਾਚੈ ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਪਿਆਰਿ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
through love of the Guru and love for the True One. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
ਭਗਤਿ ਕਰੇ; ਸੋ ਜਨੁ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਹੋਇ ॥
One who worships the Lord becomes pure;
through the Guru's Word, ego is eradicated from within.
ਹਰਿ ਜੀਉ; ਆਪਿ ਵਸੈ ਮਨਿ ਆਇ ॥
The dear Lord Himself comes to dwell in the mind;
one remains ever in tranquillity, merged in peace and poise. ॥2॥
Those imbued with Truth are in eternal spring;
ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਹਰਿਆ; ਰਵਿ ਗੁਣ ਗੁਵਿੰਦ ॥
their minds and bodies are rejuvenated, dwelling on the virtues of the Lord of the universe.
Without the Name the world is dry,
burning again and again in the fire of craving. ॥3॥
ਸੋਈ ਕਰੇ; ਜਿ ਹਰਿ ਜੀਉ ਭਾਵੈ ॥
One who does only what pleases the dear Lord,
ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਸਰੀਰਿ; ਭਾਣੈ ਚਿਤੁ ਲਾਵੈ ॥
and attaches his awareness to His will, has everlasting peace in the body.
He serves his God with natural ease;
Nanak, the Name comes to dwell in his mind. ॥4॥5॥
Attachment to Maya is burnt away by the Word;
mind and body are rejuvenated through love of the True Guru.
The tree bears fruit at the Lord's door,
in love with the True Word and the Name. ॥1॥
This mind is rejuvenated with natural ease;
ਸਚ ਫਲੁ ਲਾਗੈ; ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਭਾਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
through love of the True Guru, it bears the fruit of Truth. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
He Himself is near, and He Himself is far away;
ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ; ਵੇਖੈ ਸਦ ਹਜੂਰਿ ॥
through the Guru's Word, one sees Him ever present.
The plants have blossomed, giving dense shade;
the Guru-facing blossom forth with natural ease. ॥2॥
Night and day they sing kirtan of the Lord's praises, day and night;
the True Guru has removed the filth of doubt from within.
1174: Beholding the play of creation, I am wonder-struck;
as Guru-facing, the gift of the Name is obtained. ॥3॥
The Creator Himself enjoys all delights;
ਜੋ ਕਿਛੁ ਕਰੇ; ਸੋਈ ਪਰੁ ਹੋਗ ॥
whatever He does surely comes to pass.
He is the Great Giver; He has not a speck of greed.
Nanak, He is met by living the Word. ॥4॥6॥
By perfect destiny one practises Truth;
ਏਕੋ ਚੇਤੈ; ਫਿਰਿ ਜੋਨਿ. ਨ ਆਵੈ ॥
remembering the One, one does not enter reincarnation again.
ਸਫਲ ਜਨਮੁ; ਇਸੁ ਜਗ ਮਹਿ ਆਇਆ ॥
Fruitful is the coming into this world
of one who merges with natural ease in the True Name. ॥1॥
As Guru-facing, do your work lovingly attuned to Him.
ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਸੇਵਹੁ; ਵਿਚਹੁ ਆਪੁ ਗਵਾਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Serve the Lord's Name, eradicating ego from within. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
ਤਿਸੁ ਜਨ ਕੀ; ਹੈ ਸਾਚੀ ਬਾਣੀ ॥
True is the speech of that humble being;
ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ; ਜਗ ਮਾਹਿ ਸਮਾਣੀ ॥
through the Guru's Word it pervades the world.
His true fame spreads through the four ages;
the servant imbued with the Name becomes known. ॥2॥
ਇਕਿ ਸਾਚੈ ਸਬਦਿ; ਰਹੇ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਇ ॥
Some remain lovingly attuned to the True Word;
those humble beings are true, in love with the True One.
They meditate on the True Lord, beholding Him ever present;
ਸੰਤ ਜਨਾ ਕੀ; ਪਗ ਪੰਕਜ ਧੂਰਿ ॥੩॥
they are the dust of the lotus feet of the saints. ॥3॥
There is only the One Creator; there is no other.
Through the Guru's Word, union with Him is attained.
ਜਿਨਿ ਸਚੁ ਸੇਵਿਆ; ਤਿਨਿ ਰਸੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
One who serves the True Lord finds delight;
Nanak, he is absorbed in the Name with natural ease. ॥4॥7॥
The humble devotees worship the Lord, beholding Him ever present;
ਸੰਤ ਜਨਾ ਕੀ; ਪਗ ਪੰਕਜ ਧੂਰਿ ॥
they are the dust of the lotus feet of the saints.
ਹਰਿ ਸੇਤੀ; ਸਦ ਰਹਹਿ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਇ ॥
They remain ever lovingly attuned to the Lord;
the perfect True Guru has given them this understanding. ॥1॥
ਦਾਸਾ ਕਾ ਦਾਸੁ; ਵਿਰਲਾ ਕੋਈ ਹੋਇ ॥
Rare is the one who becomes the slave of His slaves;
he attains the supreme state. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
Serve the One Lord, and no other;
serving Him, there is everlasting peace.
ਨਾ ਓਹੁ ਮਰੈ; ਨ ਆਵੈ ਜਾਇ ॥
He does not die, nor come and go;
ਤਿਸੁ ਬਿਨੁ; ਅਵਰੁ ਸੇਵੀ ਕਿਉ ਮਾਇ ॥੨॥
why should I serve any other but Him, O mother? ॥2॥
ਸੇ ਜਨ ਸਾਚੇ; ਜਿਨੀ ਸਾਚੁ ਪਛਾਣਿਆ ॥
True are those humble beings who realise the True Lord;
subduing ego, they merge with natural ease in the Name.
As Guru-facing, they obtain the Name;
their minds are pure, and they see the pure True Lord. ॥3॥
ਜਿਨਿ ਗਿਆਨੁ ਕੀਆ; ਤਿਸੁ ਹਰਿ ਤੂ ਜਾਣੁ ॥
Know the Lord, who has given you spiritual wisdom;
through the True Word, recognise the One God.
ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਚਾਖੈ; ਤਾਂ ਸੁਧਿ ਹੋਇ ॥
When one tastes the Lord's essence, one becomes aware;
Nanak, those imbued with the Name see the True One. ॥4॥8॥
ਨਾਮਿ ਰਤੇ; ਕੁਲਾਂ ਕਾ ਕਰਹਿ ਉਧਾਰੁ ॥
Those imbued with the Name save their generations;
they love the True Word and the Name.
Why did the deluded self-willed even come into the world?
Forgetting the Name, they waste their lives. ॥1॥
One who dies while yet alive, dying, embellishes his death;
ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ; ਸਾਚੁ ਉਰ ਧਾਰੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
through the Guru's Word he enshrines the True Lord in his heart. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
Truth is the food of the Guru-facing; their bodies are sanctified;
their minds are pure; the deep Treasure of virtue ever dwells within.
They are not born, they do not die, they do not come and go;
by the Guru's grace they merge in the True One. ॥2॥
Serve the True Lord, and realise the True One;
ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ; ਹਰਿ ਦਰਿ ਨੀਸਾਣੈ ॥
through the Guru's Word one bears the insignia at the Lord's door.
1175: At the True Door one obtains true glory,
and finds a dwelling in one's own true home. ॥3॥
He Himself is infallible; He is the Truest of the true;
ਹੋਰਿ ਸਭਿ ਭੂਲਹਿ; ਦੂਜੈ ਪਤਿ ਖੋਇ ॥
all others make mistakes, losing their honour in duality.
Serve the True Lord through the True Word;
Nanak, through the Name one merges in the True One. ॥4॥9॥
Without His grace, all are deluded by doubt;
in attachment to Maya they suffer terrible pain.
The blind self-willed find no place of rest;
ਬਿਸਟਾ ਕਾ ਕੀੜਾ; ਬਿਸਟਾ ਮਾਹਿ ਸਮਾਈ ॥੧॥
like the worm in filth, they remain absorbed in filth. ॥1॥
That humble being who obeys His command is accepted;
ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ; ਨਾਮਿ ਨੀਸਾਣੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
through the Guru's Word he bears the insignia of the Name. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
ਸਾਚਿ ਰਤੇ; ਜਿਨੑਾ ਧੁਰਿ ਲਿਖਿ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
Those with such destiny prerecorded are imbued with Truth;
ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਨਾਮੁ; ਸਦਾ ਮਨਿ ਭਾਇਆ ॥
the Lord's Name is ever pleasing to their minds.
ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਬਾਣੀ; ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਹੋਇ ॥
Through the True Guru's Word there is everlasting peace;
He merges their light in the Light. ॥2॥
The Name of the One Lord carries the world across;
by the Guru's grace, one comes to love the Name.
ਬਿਨੁ ਨਾਮੈ ਮੁਕਤਿ; ਕਿਨੈ. ਨ ਪਾਈ ॥
Without the Name, no one has obtained liberation;
ਪੂਰੇ ਗੁਰ ਤੇ; ਨਾਮੁ ਪਲੈ ਪਾਈ ॥੩॥
from the perfect Guru the Name is obtained. ॥3॥
He alone understands whom the Lord Himself makes understand;
serving the True Guru, the Name is implanted within.
ਜਿਨ ਇਕੁ ਜਾਤਾ; ਸੇ ਜਨ ਪਰਵਾਣੁ ॥
Those humble beings who know the One are approved;
Nanak, imbued with the Name, they bear His insignia at His door. ॥4॥10॥
Showing His mercy, He leads one to meet the True Guru;
He Himself comes to dwell in the mind.
One's intellect becomes steady, and the mind is ever patient;
one sings the praises of the Lord, the deep Treasure of virtue. ॥1॥
Those who forget the Name die eating poison;
ਬ੍ਰਿਥਾ ਜਨਮੁ; ਫਿਰਿ ਆਵਹਿ ਜਾਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
their lives are wasted, and they keep coming and going. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
ਬਹੁ ਭੇਖ ਕਰਹਿ; ਮਨਿ ਸਾਂਤਿ. ਨ ਹੋਇ ॥
They wear all sorts of religious garb, but their minds are not at peace;
in great pride they lose their honour.
Very fortunate are those who realise the Word;
they bring their wandering minds back home. ॥2॥
Within the home of the self is the inaccessible, infinite treasure;
those who seek it through the Guru's teaching reflect on the Word,
ਨਾਮੁ ਨਵ ਨਿਧਿ ਪਾਈ; ਘਰ ਹੀ ਮਾਹਿ ॥
and obtain the nine treasures of the Name within their own home;
ever imbued with His love, they merge in the True One. ॥3॥
ਆਪਿ ਕਰੇ; ਕਿਛੁ ਕਰਣੁ. ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥
He Himself does all; no one can do anything by oneself;
when it pleases Him, He merges one into Himself.
ਤਿਸ ਤੇ ਨੇੜੈ ਨਾਹੀ ਕੋ ਦੂਰਿ ॥
No one is near Him or far from Him;
Nanak, He fully pervades through the Name. ॥4॥11॥
Through the Guru's Word, remember the Lord with love,
and remain satisfied with the essence of the Lord's Name.
ਕੋਟ ਕੋਟੰਤਰ ਕੇ ਪਾਪ; ਜਲਿ ਜਾਹਿ ॥
The sins of millions upon millions of lifetimes are burnt away;
remaining dead while yet alive, one merges in the Lord's Name. ॥1॥
ਹਰਿ ਕੀ ਦਾਤਿ; ਹਰਿ ਜੀਉ ਜਾਣੈ ॥
The dear Lord Himself knows His own gifts.
ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਇਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਮਉਲਿਆ; ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣਦਾਤਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਖਾਣੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
This mind blossoms forth through the Guru's Word, chanting the Name of the Lord, the Giver of virtue. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
ਭਗਵੈ ਵੇਸਿ ਭ੍ਰਮਿ; ਮੁਕਤਿ. ਨ ਹੋਇ ॥
No one is liberated by wandering around in saffron robes;
ਬਹੁ ਸੰਜਮਿ; ਸਾਂਤਿ. ਨ ਪਾਵੈ ਕੋਇ ॥
no one finds peace through strict self-discipline;
through the Guru's teaching, the Name is obtained;
by great good fortune one finds the Lord. ॥2॥
In this Dark Age, glorious greatness comes through the Lord's Name;
1176: it is obtained from the perfect Guru.
Imbued with the Name, one finds everlasting peace;
without the Name, one burns in ego. ॥3॥
By great good fortune, one contemplates the Lord's Name;
through the Lord's Name, all sorrow is dispelled.
He who dwells in the heart pervades the expanse outside as well;
Nanak, He knows that the Creator is in all. ॥4॥12॥
I am a worm, a creature created by You;
if You bless me, I chant Your primal mantra. ॥1॥
I chant and reflect on His virtues, O my mother;
ਹਰਿ ਜਪਿ; ਹਰਿ ਕੈ ਲਗਉ ਪਾਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
meditating on the Lord, I fall at the Lord's feet. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
By the Guru's grace, one comes to savour the taste of the Name;
why waste your life in hatred and conflict? ॥2॥
The Guru showed mercy, and my ego was eradicated;
with natural love, I have obtained the Lord's Name. ॥3॥
The most sublime and exalted occupation is the Word;
The plants have blossomed; spring has come;
this mind blossoms in the company of the True Guru. ॥1॥
Meditate on the True Lord, O my foolish mind;
ਤਾਂ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਵਹੁ; ਮੇਰੇ ਮਨਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
only then shall you find peace, O my mind. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
As this mind blossoms, bliss arises;
one obtains the nectar fruit, the Name of the Lord of the universe. ॥2॥
Everyone speaks and says that the Lord is One and only One;
but only by realising His command does one truly know the One. ॥3॥
ਕਹਤ ਨਾਨਕੁ; ਹਉਮੈ ਕਹੈ. ਨ ਕੋਇ ॥
Says Nanak, no one should speak through ego;
ਆਖਣੁ ਵੇਖਣੁ ਸਭੁ; ਸਾਹਿਬ ਤੇ ਹੋਇ ॥੪॥੨॥੧੪॥
all speaking and seeing come from the Lord and Master. ॥4॥2॥14॥
All the ages were created by You;
meeting the True Guru, one's intellect is awakened. ॥1॥
Dear Lord, You Yourself unite one with Yourself;
ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ; ਸਚ ਨਾਮਿ ਸਮਾਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
through the Guru's Word, one merges in the True Name. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
With spring in the mind, all people are rejuvenated;
ਫਲਹਿ ਫੁਲੀਅਹਿ; ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮਿ ਸੁਖੁ ਹੋਇ ॥੨॥
they blossom and bear fruit, and through the Lord's Name there is peace. ॥2॥
One who reflects on the Guru's Word is in eternal spring,
keeping the Lord's Name enshrined in the heart. ॥3॥
ਮਨਿ ਬਸੰਤੁ; ਤਨੁ ਮਨੁ ਹਰਿਆ ਹੋਇ ॥
When spring comes into the mind, body and mind are rejuvenated;
ਨਾਨਕ. ਇਹੁ ਤਨੁ ਬਿਰਖੁ; ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਫਲੁ ਪਾਏ ਸੋਇ ॥੪॥੩॥੧੫॥
Nanak, this body is a tree that bears the fruit of the Lord's Name. ॥4॥3॥15॥
ਤਿਨੑ ਬਸੰਤੁ; ਜੋ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਇ ॥
They alone have spring who sing the Lord's praises;
by perfect destiny, one is made to worship the Lord. ॥1॥
ਇਸੁ ਮਨ ਕਉ; ਬਸੰਤ ਕੀ ਲਗੈ. ਨ ਸੋਇ ॥
This mind is not touched by spring at all;
ਇਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਜਲਿਆ; ਦੂਜੈ ਦੋਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
this mind is burnt by duality and double-mindedness. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
ਇਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਧੰਧੈ ਬਾਂਧਾ; ਕਰਮ ਕਮਾਇ ॥
This mind is entangled in worldly affairs, doing deeds;
plundered by Maya, it ever cries out in pain. ॥2॥
ਇਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਛੂਟੈ; ਜਾਂ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਭੇਟੈ ॥
This mind is released when it meets the True Guru;
ਜਮਕਾਲ ਕੀ; ਫਿਰਿ ਆਵੈ. ਨ ਫੇਟੈ ॥੩॥
then it is not struck by the Messenger of Death. ॥3॥
ਇਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਛੂਟਾ; ਗੁਰਿ. ਲੀਆ ਛਡਾਇ ॥
This mind is released when the Guru releases it;
Nanak, attachment to Maya is burnt away by the Word. ॥4॥4॥16॥
Spring has come, and the plants have blossomed;
ਏਹਿ ਜੀਅ ਜੰਤ ਫੂਲਹਿ; ਹਰਿ ਚਿਤੁ ਲਾਇ ॥੧॥
these beings and creatures blossom when their awareness is attached to the Lord. ॥1॥
1177: ਇਨ ਬਿਧਿ; ਇਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਹਰਿਆ ਹੋਇ ॥
In this way, this mind is rejuvenated:
ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪੈ ਦਿਨੁ ਰਾਤੀ; ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ. ਹਉਮੈ ਕਢੈ ਧੋਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
chanting the Name of the Lord, Har Har, day and night; as Guru-facing, ego is washed away. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
The True Guru utters the Word and the Bani;
this world blossoms forth through love of the True Guru. ॥2॥
ਫਲ ਫੂਲ ਲਾਗੇ; ਜਾਂ ਆਪੇ ਲਾਏ ॥
The fruit and flowers come when the Lord Himself makes them grow;
one is attached to the root when one meets the True Guru. ॥3॥
He Himself is the springtime; the whole world is His garden;
Nanak, by perfect destiny comes unique devotion. ॥4॥5॥17॥
Basant Hindol · Guru Amar Das · Ghar 2
One Creator, realised by the Guru's grace
ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਬਾਣੀ ਵਿਟਹੁ. ਵਾਰਿਆ ਭਾਈ; ਗੁਰਸਬਦ ਵਿਟਹੁ. ਬਲਿ ਜਾਈ ॥
I am a sacrifice to the Guru's Bani, O brother; I am devoted to the Guru's Word.
ਗੁਰੁ ਸਾਲਾਹੀ ਸਦ ਅਪਣਾ ਭਾਈ; ਗੁਰ ਚਰਣੀ ਚਿਤੁ ਲਾਈ ॥੧॥
I ever praise my Guru, O brother, and focus my awareness on the Guru's feet. ॥1॥
ਮੇਰੇ ਮਨ; ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮਿ ਚਿਤੁ ਲਾਇ ॥
O my mind, focus your awareness on the Lord's Name;
ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਤੇਰਾ ਹਰਿਆ ਹੋਵੈ; ਇਕੁ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮਾ ਫਲੁ ਪਾਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
your mind and body shall blossom, and you shall obtain the fruit of the One Lord's Name. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
ਗੁਰਿ ਰਾਖੇ. ਸੇ ਉਬਰੇ ਭਾਈ; ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਪੀਆਇ ॥
Those whom the Guru protects are saved, O brother; He gives them the nectar of the Lord's essence to drink.
ਵਿਚਹੁ. ਹਉਮੈ ਦੁਖੁ ਉਠਿ ਗਇਆ ਭਾਈ; ਸੁਖੁ ਵੁਠਾ ਮਨਿ ਆਇ ॥੨॥
The pain of ego is removed from within, O brother, and peace comes to dwell in the mind. ॥2॥
ਧੁਰਿ ਆਪੇ ਜਿਨੑਾ ਨੋ ਬਖਸਿਓਨੁ ਭਾਈ; ਸਬਦੇ ਲਇਅਨੁ ਮਿਲਾਇ ॥
Those whom the Primal Lord Himself forgives, O brother, He unites with Himself through the Word.
ਧੂੜਿ ਤਿਨੑਾ ਕੀ. ਅਘੁਲੀਐ ਭਾਈ; ਸਤਸੰਗਤਿ ਮੇਲਿ ਮਿਲਾਇ ॥੩॥
One is liberated by the dust of their feet, O brother; He unites one in the true congregation. ॥3॥
ਆਪਿ ਕਰਾਏ ਕਰੇ ਆਪਿ ਭਾਈ; ਜਿਨਿ ਹਰਿਆ ਕੀਆ. ਸਭੁ ਕੋਇ ॥
He Himself acts and causes others to act, O brother; He has made all flourish.
ਨਾਨਕ. ਮਨਿ ਤਨਿ ਸੁਖੁ ਸਦ ਵਸੈ ਭਾਈ; ਸਬਦਿ ਮਿਲਾਵਾ ਹੋਇ ॥੪॥੧॥੧੮॥੧੨॥੧੮॥੩੦॥
Nanak, peace ever dwells in mind and body, O brother, for one united through the Word. ॥4॥1॥18॥12॥18॥30॥
Basant · Iktuke · Guru Ram Das · Ghar 1
One Creator, realised by the Guru's grace
As the rays of sunlight spread out,
ਤਿਉ ਘਟਿ ਘਟਿ ਰਮਈਆ; ਓਤਿ ਪੋਤਿ ॥੧॥
so the Lord pervades each and every heart, through and through. ॥1॥
The One Lord is pervading in all places;
through the Guru's Word He is met, O my mother. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
ਘਟਿ ਘਟਿ ਅੰਤਰਿ; ਏਕੋ ਹਰਿ ਸੋਇ ॥
The One Lord is deep within each and every heart;
meeting the Guru, the One Lord becomes manifest. ॥2॥
The One and only Lord is pervading everywhere;
the greedy, faithless cynic thinks He is far away. ॥3॥
The One and only Lord pervades the world;
ਨਾਨਕ. ਹਰਿ ਏਕੋੁ ਕਰੇ; ਸੁ ਹੋਇ ॥੪॥੧॥
Nanak, whatever the One Lord does comes to pass. ॥4॥1॥
Day and night, the two calls are sent out;
ਮਨ ਹਰਿ ਸਿਮਰਹੁ; ਅੰਤਿ ਸਦਾ ਰਖਿ ਲਏ ॥੧॥
O mind, remember the Lord, who will protect you in the end. ॥1॥
ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਚੇਤਿ; ਸਦਾ ਮਨ ਮੇਰੇ ॥
Remember the Lord, Har Har, forever, O my mind;
ਸਭੁ ਆਲਸੁ ਦੂਖ ਭੰਜਿ. ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਪਾਇਆ; ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਗਾਵਹੁ ਗੁਣ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੇਰੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
shattering all laziness and pain, God is found; through the Guru's teaching, sing God's praises. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
The self-willed die again and again in ego;
1178: ਕਾਲਿ ਦੈਤਿ ਸੰਘਾਰੇ; ਜਮ ਪੁਰਿ ਗਏ ॥੨॥
they are killed by the demon of death and go to the city of Death. ॥2॥
ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ; ਹਰਿ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਗੇ ॥
The Guru-facing are lovingly attuned to the Lord, Har Har;
both the pains of birth and death are removed. ॥3॥
ਭਗਤ ਜਨਾ ਕਉ; ਹਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਧਾਰੀ ॥
The Lord has shown mercy to His humble devotees;
Guru Nanak is pleased, and one has met the Lord of the world. ॥4॥2॥
Basant Hindol · Guru Ram Das · Ghar 2
One Creator, realised by the Guru's grace
ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਰਤਨ ਕੋਠੜੀ; ਗੜ ਮੰਦਰਿ ਏਕ ਲੁਕਾਨੀ ॥
The Lord's Name is a chamber full of jewels, hidden away in the fortress-temple of the body.
ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਮਿਲੈ. ਤ ਖੋਜੀਐ; ਮਿਲਿ ਜੋਤੀ ਜੋਤਿ ਸਮਾਨੀ ॥੧॥
When one meets the True Guru, one searches and finds it, and one's light merges with the Light. ॥1॥
O Lord, lead me to meet the holy ones.
ਦੇਖਤ ਦਰਸੁ. ਪਾਪ ਸਭਿ ਨਾਸਹਿ; ਪਵਿਤ੍ਰ ਪਰਮ ਪਦੁ ਪਾਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Beholding their sight, all sins are erased, and one obtains the supreme, sanctified state. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
ਪੰਚ ਚੋਰ ਮਿਲਿ ਲਾਗੇ ਨਗਰੀਆ; ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਧਨੁ ਹਿਰਿਆ ॥
The five thieves join together and plunder the body-village, robbing the wealth of the Lord's Name;
ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਖੋਜ ਪਰੇ. ਤਬ ਪਕਰੇ; ਧਨੁ ਸਾਬਤੁ ਰਾਸਿ ਉਬਰਿਆ ॥੨॥
but through the Guru's teaching they are traced and caught, and the wealth is recovered intact. ॥2॥
ਪਾਖੰਡ ਭਰਮ ਉਪਾਵ ਕਰਿ ਥਾਕੇ; ਰਿਦ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਮਾਇਆ ਮਾਇਆ ॥
Practising hypocrisy and superstition, people grow weary, yet within their hearts is Maya, Maya.
ਸਾਧੂ ਪੁਰਖੁ. ਪੁਰਖਪਤਿ ਪਾਇਆ; ਅਗਿਆਨ ਅੰਧੇਰੁ ਗਵਾਇਆ ॥੩॥
By the grace of the holy Guru, the Master of men, the darkness of ignorance is dispelled. ॥3॥
ਜਗੰਨਾਥ ਜਗਦੀਸ ਗੁਸਾਈ; ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਸਾਧੁ ਮਿਲਾਵੈ ॥
The Lord of the universe, Master of the world, in His mercy leads one to meet the Holy Guru;
ਨਾਨਕ. ਸਾਂਤਿ ਹੋਵੈ ਮਨ ਅੰਤਰਿ; ਨਿਤ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵੈ ॥੪॥੧॥੩॥
Nanak, then peace comes into the mind, and one ever sings the Lord's praises within the heart. ॥4॥1॥3॥
ਤੁਮੑ ਵਡ ਪੁਰਖ, ਵਡ ਅਗਮ ਗੁਸਾਈ; ਹਮ ਕੀਰੇ ਕਿਰਮ. ਤੁਮਨਛੇ ॥
You are the Great Being, the inaccessible Lord of the world; we are mere worms and insects created by You.
ਹਰਿ ਦੀਨ ਦਇਆਲ ਕਰਹੁ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕਿਰਪਾ; ਗੁਰ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਚਰਣ ਹਮ ਬਨਛੇ ॥੧॥
O Lord, Merciful to the meek, show mercy, God; I long for the feet of the Guru, the True Guru. ॥1॥
ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ਜੀਉ. ਸਤਸੰਗਤਿ ਮੇਲਿ; ਕਰਿ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਛੇ ॥
O dear Lord of the universe, be merciful and unite me with the true congregation.
ਜਨਮ ਜਨਮ ਕੇ ਕਿਲਵਿਖ ਮਲੁ ਭਰਿਆ; ਮਿਲਿ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਕਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਹਨਛੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
I am filled with the filth of sins from countless lifetimes; joining the congregation, make me pure, O God. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
ਤੁਮੑਰਾ ਜਨੁ, ਜਾਤਿ ਅਵਿਜਾਤਾ; ਹਰਿ ਜਪਿਓ, ਪਤਿਤ. ਪਵੀਛੇ ॥
Your humble servant, of high or low caste, who meditates on You, O Lord, the Purifier of sinners —
ਹਰਿ ਕੀਓ ਸਗਲ ਭਵਨ ਤੇ ਊਪਰਿ; ਹਰਿ ਸੋਭਾ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਦਿਨਛੇ ॥੨॥
the Lord exalts him above the whole world and blesses him with glory. ॥2॥
ਜਾਤਿ ਅਜਾਤਿ ਕੋਈ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਧਿਆਵੈ; ਸਭਿ ਪੂਰੇ ਮਾਨਸ ਤਿਨਛੇ ॥
Whoever meditates on God, of high caste or low, all their hopes are fulfilled;
ਸੇ ਧੰਨਿ ਵਡੇ. ਵਡ ਪੂਰੇ ਹਰਿ ਜਨ; ਜਿਨੑ ਹਰਿ ਧਾਰਿਓ, ਹਰਿ ਉਰਛੇ ॥੩॥
blessed, great and perfect are the Lord's humble servants who enshrine the Lord in their hearts. ॥3॥
ਹਮ ਢੀਂਢੇ ਢੀਮ ਬਹੁਤੁ ਅਤਿ ਭਾਰੀ; ਹਰਿ ਧਾਰਿ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਮਿਲਛੇ ॥
I am lowly and a great fool, heavy with sins; show mercy, Lord God, and meet me.
ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰੁ ਪਾਇਆ. ਹਰਿ ਤੂਠੇ; ਹਮ ਕੀਏ ਪਤਿਤ. ਪਵੀਛੇ ॥੪॥੨॥੪॥
Servant Nanak has found the Guru; the Lord is pleased, and has purified this sinner. ॥4॥2॥4॥
ਮੇਰਾ ਇਕੁ ਖਿਨੁ ਮਨੂਆ ਰਹਿ. ਨ ਸਕੈ; ਨਿਤ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮ ਰਸਿ ਗੀਧੇ ॥
My mind cannot survive even an instant; it is ever absorbed in the essence of the Lord's Name, Har Har,
ਜਿਉ ਬਾਰਿਕੁ. ਰਸਕਿ ਪਰਿਓ ਥਨਿ ਮਾਤਾ; ਥਨਿ ਕਾਢੇ ਬਿਲਲ ਬਿਲੀਧੇ ॥੧॥
like a child, delighting in its mother's breast, who cries out when the breast is taken away. ॥1॥
ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ਜੀਉ; ਮੇਰੇ ਮਨ ਤਨ ਨਾਮ ਹਰਿ ਬੀਧੇ ॥
O dear Lord of the universe, my mind and body are pierced by the Lord's Name.
ਵਡੈ ਭਾਗਿ ਗੁਰੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਪਾਇਆ; ਵਿਚਿ ਕਾਇਆ ਨਗਰ ਹਰਿ ਸੀਧੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
By great good fortune I have found the Guru, the True Guru, and within the body-village the Lord is revealed. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
1179: ਜਨ ਕੇ ਸਾਸ. ਸਾਸ ਹੈ ਜੇਤੇ; ਹਰਿ ਬਿਰਹਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਹਰਿ ਬੀਧੇ ॥
Every breath of the Lord's humble servant is pierced by the love of the Lord God,
ਜਿਉ ਜਲ ਕਮਲ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਅਤਿ ਭਾਰੀ; ਬਿਨੁ ਜਲ ਦੇਖੇ, ਸੁਕਲੀਧੇ ॥੨॥
like the lotus deeply in love with the water, which withers without seeing it. ॥2॥
ਜਨ ਜਪਿਓ. ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਰੰਜਨੁ ਨਰਹਰਿ; ਉਪਦੇਸਿ ਗੁਰੂ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰੀਧੇ ॥
The humble servant chants the immaculate Name of the Lord; through the Guru's teaching, the Lord is revealed.
ਜਨਮ ਜਨਮ ਕੀ ਹਉਮੈ ਮਲੁ ਨਿਕਸੀ; ਹਰਿ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤਿ ਹਰਿ ਜਲਿ ਨੀਧੇ ॥੩॥
The filth of ego of countless lifetimes is washed off, bathing in the nectar water of the Lord. ॥3॥
ਹਮਰੇ ਕਰਮ. ਨ ਬਿਚਰਹੁ ਠਾਕੁਰ; ਤੁਮੑ ਪੈਜ ਰਖਹੁ ਅਪਨੀਧੇ ॥
Please do not take my deeds into account, O Master; preserve the honour of Your slave.
ਹਰਿ ਭਾਵੈ ਸੁਣਿ ਬਿਨਉ ਬੇਨਤੀ; ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ. ਸਰਣਿ ਪਵੀਧੇ ॥੪॥੩॥੫॥
O Lord, if it pleases You, hear my prayer; servant Nanak seeks Your sanctuary. ॥4॥3॥5॥
ਮਨੁ ਖਿਨੁ ਖਿਨੁ ਭਰਮਿ ਭਰਮਿ ਬਹੁ ਧਾਵੈ; ਤਿਲੁ ਘਰਿ ਨਹੀ ਵਾਸਾ ਪਾਈਐ ॥
Each moment the mind wanders around in doubt and runs about; it does not stay in its own home even for an instant.
ਗੁਰਿ ਅੰਕਸੁ. ਸਬਦੁ ਦਾਰੂ ਸਿਰਿ ਧਾਰਿਓ; ਘਰਿ ਮੰਦਰਿ ਆਣਿ ਵਸਾਈਐ ॥੧॥
When the Guru places the goad of the Word, the medicine, on its head, it comes back to dwell in the temple of its own home. ॥1॥
ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ਜੀਉ, ਸਤਸੰਗਤਿ ਮੇਲਿ; ਹਰਿ ਧਿਆਈਐ ॥
O dear Lord of the universe, unite me with the true congregation, that I may meditate on You, Lord.
ਹਉਮੈ ਰੋਗੁ ਗਇਆ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ; ਹਰਿ ਸਹਜਿ ਸਮਾਧਿ ਲਗਾਈਐ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
The disease of ego is cured and peace is found; one is absorbed in the samadhi of poise. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
ਘਰਿ ਰਤਨ ਲਾਲ ਬਹੁ ਮਾਣਕ ਲਾਦੇ; ਮਨੁ ਭ੍ਰਮਿਆ. ਲਹਿ, ਨ ਸਕਾਈਐ ॥
This home is loaded with countless jewels, rubies and emeralds, but the wandering mind cannot find them.
ਜਿਉ ਓਡਾ, ਕੂਪੁ ਗੁਹਜ ਖਿਨ ਕਾਢੈ; ਤਿਉ. ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਵਸਤੁ ਲਹਾਈਐ ॥੨॥
As the water-diviner finds the hidden well in an instant, so through the True Guru the treasure is found. ॥2॥
ਜਿਨ ਐਸਾ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸਾਧੁ. ਨ ਪਾਇਆ; ਤੇ ਧ੍ਰਿਗੁ ਧ੍ਰਿਗੁ ਨਰ ਜੀਵਾਈਐ ॥
Those who have not found such a holy True Guru — cursed, cursed are their lives.
ਜਨਮੁ ਪਦਾਰਥੁ ਪੁੰਨਿ ਫਲੁ ਪਾਇਆ; ਕਉਡੀ ਬਦਲੈ ਜਾਈਐ ॥੩॥
The treasure of human life was obtained by virtuous deeds, but it is lost in exchange for a shell. ॥3॥
ਮਧੁਸੂਦਨ ਹਰਿ ਧਾਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕਿਰਪਾ; ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਗੁਰੂ ਮਿਲਾਈਐ ॥
O Lord, Slayer of demons, be merciful, God; in Your mercy, lead me to meet the Guru.
ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ. ਨਿਰਬਾਣ ਪਦੁ ਪਾਇਆ; ਮਿਲਿ ਸਾਧੂ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਈਐ ॥੪॥੪॥੬॥
Servant Nanak has attained the state of nirvana; meeting the holy, he sings the Lord's praises. ॥4॥4॥6॥
ਆਵਣ ਜਾਣੁ ਭਇਆ ਦੁਖੁ ਬਿਖਿਆ; ਦੇਹ ਮਨਮੁਖ ਸੁੰਞੀ ਸੁੰਞੁ ॥
Coming and going are pain and corruption; the body of the self-willed is desolate and empty.
ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ. ਖਿਨੁ ਪਲੁ, ਨਹੀ ਚੇਤਿਆ; ਜਮਿ ਪਕਰੇ, ਕਾਲਿ ਸਲੁੰਞੁ ॥੧॥
He does not remember the Lord's Name even for an instant, and so the Messenger of Death seizes him by the hair. ॥1॥
ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ਜੀਉ; ਬਿਖੁ ਹਉਮੈ ਮਮਤਾ ਮੁੰਞੁ ॥
O dear Lord of the universe, rid me of the poison of ego and possessiveness.
ਸਤਸੰਗਤਿ ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਹਰਿ ਪਿਆਰੀ; ਮਿਲਿ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਭੁੰਞੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
The true congregation of the Guru is dear to the Lord; joining the congregation, enjoy the Lord's essence. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
ਸਤਸੰਗਤਿ ਸਾਧ ਦਇਆ ਕਰਿ ਮੇਲਹੁ; ਸਰਣਾਗਤਿ ਸਾਧੂ ਪੰਞੁ ॥
In Your mercy unite me with the true congregation of the holy; I seek the sanctuary of the holy.
ਹਮ ਡੁਬਦੇ ਪਾਥਰ. ਕਾਢਿ ਲੇਹੁ ਪ੍ਰਭ; ਤੁਮੑ ਦੀਨ ਦਇਆਲ ਦੁਖ ਭੰਞੁ ॥੨॥
I am a sinking stone; pull me out, O God; You are Merciful to the meek, the Destroyer of pain. ॥2॥
ਹਰਿ ਉਸਤਤਿ ਧਾਰਹੁ ਰਿਦ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਸੁਆਮੀ; ਸਤਸੰਗਤਿ ਮਿਲਿ ਬੁਧਿ ਲੰਞੁ ॥
O Lord and Master, enshrine Your praises in my heart; joining the true congregation, my intellect is illumined.
ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੈ. ਹਮ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਲਗਾਨੀ; ਹਮ ਹਰਿ ਵਿਟਹੁ ਘੁਮਿ ਵੰਞੁ ॥੩॥
I have come to love the Lord's Name; I am a sacrifice to the Lord. ॥3॥
ਜਨ ਕੇ ਪੂਰਿ ਮਨੋਰਥ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ; ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਦੇਵਹੁ ਹਰਿ ਲੰਞੁ ॥
O Lord God, fulfil the desires of Your humble servant; bless me with the Lord's Name, the light.
ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ. ਮਨਿ ਤਨਿ ਅਨਦੁ ਭਇਆ ਹੈ; ਗੁਰਿ ਮੰਤ੍ਰੁ ਦੀਓ ਹਰਿ ਭੰਞੁ ॥੪॥੫॥੭॥੧੨॥੧੮॥੭॥੩੭॥
Servant Nanak's mind and body are in bliss; the Guru has given the mantra of the Lord's Name. ॥4॥5॥7॥12॥18॥7॥37॥
1180: One Creator, realised by the Guru's grace
I serve the Guru and bow humbly to Him;
today there are celebrations within me,
today there is supreme bliss within me;
my anxiety is gone, and I have met the Lord of the universe. ॥1॥
Today it is spring in my home;
ਗੁਨ ਗਾਏ ਪ੍ਰਭ; ਤੁਮੑ ਬੇਅੰਤ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
I sing Your praises, O infinite God. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
joining with God's companions, I have begun to play.
I celebrate Holi by serving the saints;
I am imbued with the deep crimson colour of the Lord's divine love. ॥2॥
My mind and body have blossomed forth in utter, incomparable beauty;
they do not dry out in sunshine or shade;
it is always spring when I meet the divine Guru. ॥3॥
The wish-fulfilling Elysian tree has sprouted and grown;
it bears flowers and fruits, jewels of all sorts.
I am satisfied and fulfilled, singing the Lord's praises;
ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ; ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਧਿਆਇ ॥੪॥੧॥
servant Nanak meditates on the Lord, Har Har Har. ॥4॥1॥
The shopkeeper deals in merchandise to earn profit;
the gambler's consciousness is focused on gambling;
the addict lives by consuming drugs;
ਤਿਉ ਹਰਿ ਜਨੁ ਜੀਵੈ; ਹਰਿ ਧਿਆਇ ॥੧॥
so the Lord's humble servant lives by meditating on the Lord. ॥1॥
Each is absorbed in his own pleasures;
ਜਿਤੁ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਲਾਇਆ; ਤਿਤੁ ਤਿਤੁ ਲਗੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
he is attached to whatever God attaches him to. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
When the clouds and rain come, the peacocks dance;
seeing the moon, the lotus blossoms;
when the mother sees her infant, she is happy;
ਤਿਉ ਹਰਿ ਜਨ ਜੀਵਹਿ; ਜਪਿ ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ॥੨॥
so the Lord's humble servant lives by meditating on the Lord of the universe. ॥2॥
The tiger always wants to eat meat;
looking at the battlefield, the warrior's mind is exalted;
the miser is deeply in love with his wealth;
ਹਰਿ ਜਨ ਕਉ; ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਆਧਾਰੁ ॥੩॥
the Lord's humble servant leans on the support of the Lord, Har Har. ॥3॥
All love is contained in the love of the One Lord;
ਸਰਬ ਸੁਖਾ ਸੁਖ; ਹਰਿ ਕੈ ਨਾਇ ॥
all comforts are contained in the comfort of the Lord's Name.
O Nanak, to whom the Guru gives this gift. ॥4॥2॥
He alone experiences spring to whom God is merciful;
he alone experiences spring to whom the Guru is merciful.
ਮੰਗਲੁ ਤਿਸ ਕੈ; ਜਿਸੁ ਏਕੁ ਕਾਮੁ ॥
He alone is joyful who works for the One Lord;
ਤਿਸੁ ਸਦ ਬਸੰਤੁ; ਜਿਸੁ ਰਿਦੈ ਨਾਮੁ ॥੧॥
he alone experiences eternal spring within whose heart is the Name. ॥1॥
I consider that spring has come to the home
ਜਾ ਕੈ ਕੀਰਤਨੁ; ਹਰਿ ਧੁਨੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
of one who sings kirtan and in whom the Lord's melody resounds. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
In love with the transcendent Lord, blossom forth, O mind;
practise spiritual wisdom, consulting the Lord's humble servants.
He alone is an ascetic who joins the company of the holy;
he alone dwells in deep meditation who loves his Guru. ॥2॥
They alone are fearless who have the fear of God;
he alone is peaceful whose doubts are dispelled;
he alone is a hermit whose heart is steady;
he alone is steady and unmoving who has found the true place. ॥3॥
He seeks the One Lord and loves the One Lord;
he longs in his heart to behold and touch His sight;
he is imbued with the Lord's love and enjoys it in poise;
servant Nanak is a sacrifice to that humble being. ॥4॥3॥
